messages.subject: Online Course: Using ChatGPT for Advanced Data Analysis 4.0
parts:
Hi everyone

Instats is pleased to be offering the 3-day seminar Using ChatGPT for Advanced Data Analysis 4.0, running twice: February 10 - 12 (for Europe/Asia time zones) and running February 24 - 26 (for the Americas). Led by Professor Peter Gruber, this seminar provides an excellent opportunity to explore how ChatGPT can be leveraged as a powerful tool for advanced data analysis, requiring only plain language statements rather than writing code or using a specific statistical software package. Ideal for academics and professional researchers, this seminar equips participants with practical techniques to enhance their analytical workflows using AI. Participants will delve into key topics such as automating data preparation, generating insights from complex datasets, and integrating ChatGPT into existing analysis pipelines. With a focus on hands-on applications, the seminar ensures attendees gain the skills needed to effectively use ChatGPT for cutting-edge data analysis tasks -- all without ever having to purchase statistical software or learn a new programming language.

Sign up today to secure your spot for the February 10 - 12 (for Europe/Asia time zones) seminar or the February 24 - 26 (for the Americas) seminar, and please feel free to share this opportunity with colleagues and students who might benefit.


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Director
